meta.title: Best & Worst Times to Visit Da Nang | Avoid Typhoon Season
meta.description:
Get the real truth about visiting or moving to Danang, Vietnam. After two years of living here, Mai breaks down the best and worst months, what each season actually feels like, and what to expect during rainy and typhoon season. Plus, insider tips from a local expat mom and how to plan your trip right. Join the Abundant Living Collective for more life-abroad insights.

comments.author: @wanderwithmeg
comments.text: Travelling to Da Nang 1st to 2nd week of January. I don’t mind the misty, breezy, humid and cold weather, and I’m also ok with a little bit of drizzle. But I wanna know around January, do the intensities and frequencies of the typhoons / heavy rain die down?? LOVE YOUR VID BTW!

comments.author: @maiabundant
comments.text: Thank you! 🤍 From my experience, January is usually less intense than the peak rainy/typhoon period, but the weather can still be unpredictable. I’ve lived through two rainy seasons here and every year has honestly been different. I’d still pack for some rain.
